src: They keep coming and asking for more. But the flesh is only growing so fast. I don't know what to do.||||I told them it doesn't work how they think it does. But they keep on trying. Something about achieving full power - Idiots.||||When they look away, I'll run. I got my secret exit and hideout they don't know about.

PROTECT THE HOUSE!!!||||Don't let anybody enter!!!||||Once we succeed here, we are one step closer to true freedom!!!||||FUCK GOD AND THE REST!||||And please, don't mess around with the beds too much.

So. Much. Flesh.||||To think that he told us he would run out soon. Ridiculous. ||There is so much.||||I tried a little bit yesterday. It tastes just like the usual, even if it looks different. ||But last night I had a marvellous dream. If only I could remember it.

They were searching for the biggest meat eaters among us. Sadly I haven't been selected.||||They are now sitting in one of the rooms, eating nothing but the flesh from around us, day and night.||||I heard that they stopped sleeping. New flesh is transported into their room constantly.||||Why couldn't I be one of them? I want more flesh! Maybe, when the others aren't looking I can grab some? I'm sure they won't notice if some of it goes missing.

The stories are true. Some of them have turned into... something? They are like animals now. Following just their instincts. And eating.||They still seem to recognize us. They are not agressive.||We placed them outside. Let them help the guards.||||Now where can I find more flesh?||I need some Flesh.

The flesh is calling. And I have it.||||This last piece is mine. Mine.||||They argued that it's dangerous.||||They said I should give it away.||They would destroy it. Make me feel good again.||||But they are wrong. I feel good.||This is mine, and they will not get it.||||I will protect it.

Citizen.||||We are sad to inform you that you are unfit to continue living among us.||||Effective immediately, your citizenship has been revoked.||You have been released to the surface world to continue your life separate from our UNIVERSAL SOCIETY.||||Please follow the regulations of the free world:||||#1||Do not, under any circumstance, enter a settlement of the UNIVERSAL SOCIETY!||||#2||Do not reproduce!||||If you break any of these rules, you will be terminated.||If you need advice on how to live your life on the surface, please ask an integration assistant for more info.||||We wish you a happy life outside of our society.

Some of you may have heard the rumours that some time ago one of our members deserted to start a career as a priest in New Delphi.||||This is not true.||||We are the strongest.||||Nobody can or will ever desert from us.||||And if they do, their death is imminent.||||So don't even think about running away!||||FUCK GOD AND THE REST!
Having a cup of tea at your desk is fine and all. But guys, please put them in the washer when you're finished. This place reeks of dirty dishes.

FT-6 is an incredible improvement on the FT-5 model.||Through the compact hydromagnetic levitators recoil could be reduced by up to 15%, leading to overall higher accuracy.||||The new propulsors have increased the max velocity by 1.5 m/s, and the max distance travelled before a recharge is required has still not been found. The FT-6 has been on the track for several weeks now.||||The only downside of the changes we are currently aware of, is that the cheaper materials used by the chipset production are more sensitive to temperature, leading to early corruption on highly active models.

Look, we know it's your first time presenting. And yes, some of the guys coming are high ranking. But we've all been there. It's not as bad as you think.||||I remember the first time they sent me. I almost pissed my pants. My mind completely blanked. To be honest, I don't really remember what I said. I think I just went through the list of features, showed off the bot moving and that was it. Over. And that was apparently good enough.||||Here's an idea: Once it's done come over. I got a nice bottle lying around, and the best drink is a shared one.

What exactly are they doing upstairs? Who are they talking to?||I've done this job in many places. It was always a fight. Nobody was willing to exchange the money for progress. Always too risky.||And yet, here we are. Far away from home, developing at a ridiculously fast pace. And whenever we need a new material, even if it is completely illegal in other sectors, we get it within days.||Who exactly is paying for this? And what are we exactly needed for?||||It's probably better not to ask.

Oh, my poor children. They put you on the track every day. Trying to improve performance. Trying to make you cheap. And you will prove it to them. One day.
